articles.title: Agentic AI for Clustering, Relationship Discovery, and Semantic Trading in Prediction Markets
articles.summary: The paper presents an agentic AI pipeline that analyzes prediction-market contract text and metadata to cluster related markets and identify cross-market dependencies or leader-follower relationships before incorporating prices. In evaluation on a large early-2026 prediction-market dataset, the system’s identified relations were 62.8% consistent with exchange-recorded settlements versus 40.6% for a natural language inference benchmark, and one semantics-based trading strategy produced a 14.12% net ROI after fees over two months.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early but concrete example of agentic AI being applied to financial market structure and trading workflows, showing how AI may uncover relationships across fragmented instruments and support new forms of signal generation. While not tied to public companies or commercial deployment, it is relevant for discussions about AI moving beyond content generation into autonomous analytical layers for markets and investment processes.
